summary: Enterprise topology reference workloads: 16 API requests/s with 500 ms p50 and 1.5 s p99, 10,000 inventory hosts, 80 job starts/s, 40 concurrent jobs at default forks plus 400 with forks=1, 40,000 events/s peak, 7 days of history at 2000 jobs/day under 60 GB, certified sync under 30 min, validated under 5 min, and 6 activations at 3 actionable events/minute.
questions: What workload can the AAP enterprise topology handle?
How many hosts does the enterprise topology support?
How many job events per second can enterprise AAP process?

answer_card.title: Enterprise topology reference workloads
answer_card.answer_md:
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| REST API | 16 RPS (p50 500 ms, p99 1.5 s) |
| Inventory hosts | 10,000 |
| Job start rate | 80 per second |
| Concurrent jobs | 40 at 5 forks + 400 at forks=1 |
| Callback receiver | 40,000 events/s peak |
| Job history | 7 days, 2000 jobs/day, under 60 GB |
| Certified / validated sync | under 30 min / under 5 min |
| EDA | 6 activations, 3 actionable events/min, skip audit events |
